spec.title: SLA clock for every complaint case
spec.goal: Operators cannot see which complaints are about to breach their response deadline. Add an SLA clock: the backend computes, for every complaint, sla_due_at from its received/created date and its severity or priority (critical 1 day, high 3 days, medium 7 days, low 15 days; treat unknown as medium), and sla_status: 'breached' when now is past the due time, 'at_risk' within the last 20% of the window, else 'on_track'. Expose sla_due_at and sla_status on the complaint list and detail APIs. In the frontend Cases workspace (and the Complaints list if it shows the same records), show an SLA badge per case with a clear label and color, and add a filter to show only cases that are at risk or breached. Add backend unit tests for the SLA computation (including boundary cases) and an API test, plus a frontend test for the badge.
spec.constraints: Compute SLA in one backend function; do not duplicate the rules in the frontend. Keep existing API fields unchanged (only add). All checks must pass.

tasks.title: Implement single SLA computation function in backend service layer
acceptance: A single new backend function computes sla_due_at from received/created date and severity/priority using critical=1d, high=3d, medium=7d, low=15d, unknown=medium.
The same function computes sla_status: 'breached' when now > sla_due_at, 'at_risk' when within the last 20% of the window, else 'on_track'.
Boundary behavior is defined and deterministic (exact due time counts as breached; exact 20% threshold is at_risk).
Unknown or missing severity/priority falls back to medium and never raises.

tasks.title: Add backend unit tests for SLA computation incl. boundaries
acceptance: Unit tests cover all four severities plus unknown fallback to medium.
Tests cover on_track, at_risk, and breached states and the exact boundary instants for due time and the 20% window.
Tests cover missing/invalid case timestamps without crashing.
New tests pass under scripts/atlas/test-backend.sh.

tasks.title: Expose sla_due_at and sla_status on complaint list and detail APIs
acceptance: GET /api/complaints items include sla_due_at and sla_status computed by the shared SLA function.
GET /api/complaints/{complaint_id} includes sla_due_at and sla_status.
No existing response fields are removed or renamed; changes are purely additive.
Backend starts and the two endpoints return 200 with the new fields.

acceptance: API test calls GET /api/complaints and GET /api/complaints/{complaint_id} and asserts sla_due_at and sla_status are present.

Test asserts existing fields remain unchanged (additive-only).
New API test passes under scripts/atlas/test-backend.sh.

acceptance: A reusable SLA badge renders a clear label and distinct color for on_track, at_risk, and breached.

Badge handles missing SLA fields gracefully (no crash).
Component type-checks under frontend-types-lint.
